method: Direct visual inspection of these nine actual native-runtime PNG files

images.observation: Authored industrial facade, road, blue skeletal player and HUD readable.
Facade window frames and roof edges remain identifiable from the rotated camera.
Player and street geometry remain readable after the runtime walk.
Orange energized floor and red threat silhouettes are visible.
Destroyed panel leaves a visible opening and debris; player, switch and live-floor cues remain clear.
Fallback facade, blue player and HUD remain readable; shading differs from SM6.
Fallback walk retains visible player and street surfaces.
Fallback energized orange floor and three red threats remain clearly visible with health feedback.
Fallback destroyed panel opening, debris, blue player, switch and live-floor warning remain visible.

limitations: Sparse industrial strip, unbuilt surroundings, generic mannequin presentation and simple remaining structures are unfinished world art.
Selected stills do not establish fine temporal, ghosting, disocclusion or animation-cadence quality.
No claim that all 182 captures were visually inspected; their runtime/content checks are recorded separately.
